mentions.name: Linetris
mentions.description: A daily puzzle game where players fill an 8x8 grid with Tetris-like pieces to clear lines, described as Wordle meets Tetris. Includes daily challenges, leaderboards, and competitive play against friends.
mentions.source_excerpt: Linetris ( https://apps.apple.com/us/app/linetris-daily-line-puzzle/id6759858457 ), a daily puzzle game where you fill an 8x8 grid with Tetris-like pieces to clear lines. Think Wordle meets Tetris. Daily challenges, leaderboards, and competititve play against friends.
